summary: Minimal one-character fix changing `p < 0` to `p <= 0` so the integer-shortcut branch handles arg=0 with no fractional remainder, avoiding the `prec` ValueError on inputs like '0.00'. Correct, targeted, and consistent with how floatformat already handles the no-mantissa case.

issues.description: No inline comment explaining why the boundary became <= 0 (covers arg==0 with zero remainder), but the surrounding code is similarly terse, so not required.
